FACT_ID: sec16-R01 | anchor: A01
Consider a battery-powered carbon monoxide detector for the vehicle. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0099]

FACT_ID: sec16-R02 | anchor: A01
Check or replace detector batteries when clocks change in spring and fall each year. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0099]

FACT_ID: sec16-R03 | anchor: A01
If carbon monoxide poisoning is suspected in the vehicle, leave it immediately. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0099]

FACT_ID: sec16-R04 | anchor: A01
Get fresh air immediately when vehicle carbon monoxide poisoning is suspected. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0099]

FACT_ID: sec16-R05 | anchor: A01
Seek emergency medical attention right away for suspected carbon monoxide poisoning. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0099]
